newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed, market slow.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed, market slow.

text.p: Millfeed prices were again mixed on Monday amid uneventful activity as dealers noted a lack of buying activity.
"It's a typical Monday. Everybody is busy trying to measure their bins. It is very quiet," a North Carolina dealer said.
The market has more nearby supply than what it needs. "There is no incentive (to buy) nor is there any necessity by the buyers," a St Louis dealer said.
For St Louis, spot millfeed prices dropped $1 a short ton to $78 on the bid side and $82 on the offer side.
